        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Gather metrics for all personnel using Xata's aggregation methods for preview calculations\n * \n * @returns Object mapping personnel IDs to their metrics\n */\nasync function gatherAllMetricsForPreview(): Promise\u003cRecord\u003cstring, PersonMetrics\u003e\u003e {\n  // Create a map to store metrics for each person\n  const metricsMap: Record\u003cstring, PersonMetrics\u003e = {};\n\n  // 1.         "contents": "async function gatherAllMetricsForPreview(): Promise\u003cRecord\u003cstring, PersonMetrics\u003e\u003e {\n  // Create a map to store metrics for each person\n\n  \n  ...\n\n  \n  // Process all aggregation results into a single map\n  const processAggregationResults = (\n    results: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e[], \n    idField: string, \n    countField: string, \n    metricField: keyof PersonMetrics\n  ) =\u003e {\n    results.forEach(result =\u003e {\n      if (result[idField]) {\n        const personId = result[idField] as string;\n        if (!metricsMap[personId]) {\n          metricsMap[personId] = {\n            eventParticipation: 0,\n            topicExpertise: 0,\n            organizationalAuthority: 0,\n            documentedContributions: 0,\n            testimonies: 0,\n            quotes: 0\n          };\n        }\n        metricsMap[personId][metricField] = result[countField] as number;\n      }\n    });\n  };\n  \n  // Process all aggregation results\n  processAggregationResults(eventExpertsAgg, \"subject-matter-expert.id\", \"eventCount\", \"eventParticipation\");\n  processAggregationResults(topicExpertsAgg, \"subject-matter-expert.id\", \"topicCount\", \"topicExpertise\");\n  processAggregationResults(orgMembersAgg, \"member.id\", \"orgCount\", \"organizationalAuthority\");\n  processAggregationResults(testimoniesAgg, \"witness.id\", \"testimonyCount\", \"testimonies\");\n  processAggregationResults(documentsAgg, \"author.id\", \"documentCount\", \"documentedContributions\");\n  \n  return metricsMap;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  // Test only - no authentication required\n  // In production, this should be secured\n  \n  try {\n    // Use Xata's summarize to efficiently get rank statistics\n    const rankSummary = await xata.db.personnel\n      .summarize({\n        summaries: {\n          avgRank: { average: \"rank\" },\n          maxRank: { max: \"rank\" },\n          minRank: { min: \"rank\" },\n          count: { count: \"*\" }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Fetch current personnel rankings for comparison (limited to top 20)\n    const personnel = await xata.db.personnel\n      .select([\"id\", \"name\", \"rank\", \"authority\"])\n      .sort(\"rank\", \"desc\")\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: { size: 20 }\n      });\n    \n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      message: \"Current personnel rankings\",\n      statistics: rankSummary.summaries,\n      personnel: personnel.records,\n      pagination: {\n        count: personnel.pagination.count,\n        size: personnel.pagination.size,\n        hasNextPage: personnel.hasNextPage(),\n        total: rankSummary.summaries.count\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Error in test endpoint:\", error);\n    \n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { \n        success: false, \n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n      },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  // Test only - no authentication required\n  // In production, this should be secured\n  \n  try {\n    // Use Xata's summarize to efficiently get rank statistics\n    const rankSummary = await xata.db.personnel\n      .summarize({\n        summaries: {\n          avgRank: { average: \"rank\" },\n          maxRank: { max: \"rank\" },\n          minRank: { min: \"rank\" },\n          count: { count: \"*\" }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Fetch current personnel rankings for comparison (limited to top 20)\n    const personnel = await xata.db.personnel\n      .select([\"id\", \"name\", \"rank\", \"authority\"])\n      .sort(\"rank\", \"desc\")\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: { size: 20 }\n      });\n    \n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      message: \"Current personnel rankings\",\n      statistics: rankSummary.summaries,\n      personnel: personnel.records,\n      pagination: {\n        count: personnel.pagination.count,\n        size: personnel.pagination.size,\n        hasNextPage: personnel.hasNextPage(),\n        total: rankSummary.summaries.count\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Error in test endpoint:\", error);\n    \n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { \n        success: false, \n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n      },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function POST(request: Request) {\n  // Basic authentication check - in a production environment, this should\n  // be replaced with a proper authentication mechanism (e.g., Clerk, NextAuth)\n  const authHeader = request.headers.get(\"Authorization\");\n  \n  // Simple token-based auth for demonstration\n  // In production, use a more robust auth system with environment variables\n  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith(\"Bearer \")) {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Authorization header required\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  \n  const token = authHeader.split(\" \")[1];\n  \n  // Simple auth check - replace with proper auth in production\n  // In production, use process.env.ADMIN_API_TOKEN from environment variables\n  if (token !== \"dev_admin_token\") {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Unauthorized\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  \n  try {\n    // Get custom weights from request body if provided\n    const body = await request.json().catch(() =\u003e ({}));\n    const { weights } = body as { weights?: WeightParams };\n    \n    // Execute the ranking calculation with optional custom weights\n    const result = await calculatePersonnelRanking(weights);\n    \n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      message: \"Personnel rankings updated successfully\",\n      recordsProcessed: result.recordsProcessed,\n      maxScore: result.maxScore,\n      minScore: result.minScore,\n      avgScore: result.avgScore,\n      executionTimeMs: result.executionTimeMs,\n      weightsUsed: result.weightsUsed,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Error in manual ranking update:\", error);\n    \n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { \n        success: false, \n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n      },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\nexport const executePlatformWideConnectionSearch = async ( { id, type }: any ) =\u003e {\n  const tables: any = connectionMapByEntityType[type]\n\n  const { totalCount, records } = await xata.search.all( &#96;${id}&#96;, {\n    tables: tables.map(\n      ( { table, target }: { table: string; target: string } ) =\u003e {\n        return {\n          table: &#96;${table}&#96;,\n          target: [{ column: &#96;${target}&#96;, weight: 10 }],\n        }\n      }\n    ),\n    fuzziness: 0,\n    prefix: 'phrase',\n  } )\n\n  const connectionRecords: Set\u003cany\u003e = new Set()\n\n  for ( const item of records ) {\n    const { record, table } = item\n    if ( table === 'testimonies' ) {\n      console.log( 'record: ', record )\n      const connection: any = await xata.db.testimonies.read( record?.id, ['*', 'event.*', 'witness.*'] )\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: 'testimonies',\n\n          // connectionTable,\n        } )\n\n      }\n    } else {\n      const originalRecordTypeSingular = objectMapToSingular[type]\n      const {\n        record: { xata: xataObject, ...restOfRecord },\n        table: connectionTable,\n      }: any = item\n\n      if (\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular] \u0026\u0026\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular].id === id\n      ) {\n        delete restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular]\n      }\n      const { id: recordId, ...rest } = restOfRecord\n\n      const [connectionType] = Object.keys( rest )\n\n      const table: any = objectMapPlural[connectionType]\n\n      const connectedRecordId = rest[connectionType].id\n\n      const connection: any = await xata.db[table].read( connectedRecordId )\n\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: table,\n          connectionTableId: recordId,\n          connectionTable,\n        } )\n      }\n\n    }\n\n\n    //  await xata.db[table].read( record?.id )\n    // console.log( 'connection: ', connection )\n\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Generate a summary of key figures\n * @param filter Optional filter to apply before summarizing\n * @returns Summary statistics and information about key figures\n */\nexport async function summarizeKeyFigures(\n\tfilter?: Filter\u003cPersonnelRecord\u003e,\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalCount: number;\n\tcategories?: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\trecentUpdates?: PersonnelRecord[];\n\tsummaryText?: string;\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst queryOptions: {\n\t\t\tfilter?: Filter\u003cPersonnelRecord\u003e;\n\t\t\tconsistency?: \"eventual\" | \"strong\";\n\t\t} = {\n\t\t\tconsistency: \"eventual\", // Use Replica Store for better performance\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tif (filter) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.filter = filter;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst records = await xata.db.personnel.query(queryOptions);\n\n\t\t// Count categories\n\t\tconst categories: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\tfor (const record of records.records) {\n\t\t\t// This assumes a 'category' field exists, adjust as needed\n\t\t\tconst category = record.category as string | undefined;\n\t\t\tif (category) {\n\t\t\t\tcategories[category] = (categories[category] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Get recent updates\n\t\tconst recentUpdates = await xata.db.personnel.query({\n\t\t\tsort: [[\"xata.updatedAt\", \"desc\"]],\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: 5 },\n\t\t\tconsistency: \"eventual\",\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalCount: records.records.length,\n\t\t\tcategories,\n\t\t\trecentUpdates: recentUpdates.records,\n\t\t\tsummaryText: &#96;Found ${records.records.length} key figures across ${Object.keys(categories).length} categories.&#96;,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error summarizing key figures:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Generate a summary of key figures\n * @param filter Optional filter to apply before summarizing\n * @returns Summary statistics and information about key figures\n */\nexport async function summarizeKeyFigures(\n\tfilter?: Filter\u003cPersonnelRecord\u003e,\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalCount: number;\n\tcategories?: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\trecentUpdates?: PersonnelRecord[];\n\tsummaryText?: string;\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst queryOptions: {\n\t\t\tfilter?: Filter\u003cPersonnelRecord\u003e;\n\t\t\tconsistency?: \"eventual\" | \"strong\";\n\t\t} = {\n\t\t\tconsistency: \"eventual\", // Use Replica Store for better performance\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tif (filter) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.filter = filter;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst records = await xata.db.personnel.query(queryOptions);\n\n\t\t// Count categories\n\t\tconst categories: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\tfor (const record of records.records) {\n\t\t\t// This assumes a 'category' field exists, adjust as needed\n\t\t\tconst category = record.category as string | undefined;\n\t\t\tif (category) {\n\t\t\t\tcategories[category] = (categories[category] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Get recent updates\n\t\tconst recentUpdates = await xata.db.personnel.query({\n\t\t\tsort: [[\"xata.updatedAt\", \"desc\"]],\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: 5 },\n\t\t\tconsistency: \"eventual\",\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalCount: records.records.length,\n\t\t\tcategories,\n\t\t\trecentUpdates: recentUpdates.records,\n\t\t\tsummaryText: &#96;Found ${records.records.length} key figures across ${Object.keys(categories).length} categories.&#96;,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error summarizing key figures:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",
